column7: Description
Our lab's site code for the isolate.
Sequencing facility's order/sample identifier.
NCBI GenBank assembly accession (after deposition).
NCBI SRA accession for the raw reads (after deposition).
Where the bacterium was isolated from.
GPS coordinates of the sampling site.
Elevation of the sampling site, in meters.
Nearest plant at the sampling site.
Sequencing technology used.
Total assembled genome length, base pairs.
Number of assembled sequences (1 = complete chromosome).
Whether the chromosome closed into a circle.
Assembly N50 (= genome length for a single contig).
Percent of bases that are G or C.
Mean fold coverage of the genome by reads (polished).
Number of sequencing reads generated.
Read-length N50 (50% of bases in reads this long or longer).
Median length of the reads.
Median per-read Phred quality score.
Estimated genome completeness from single-copy marker genes.
Estimated contamination from duplicated markers.
Closest GTDB species assignment.
Average nucleotide identity to that species representative.
All annotated genes (CDS + tRNA + tmRNA + rRNA + ncRNA).
Number of protein-coding genes.
Number of tRNA genes.
Number of rRNA genes (5S/16S/23S).
Number of other non-coding RNA genes.
Genes annotated as pseudogenes (disrupted/non-functional).
CDS with no known/assigned function.
Percent of the genome that is protein-coding.
